e-GP Browser is an independent browser for the public e-GP portal (www.eprocure.gov.bd). It is not made by, affiliated with or endorsed by the Government of Bangladesh, BPPA, CPTU or the e-GP portal.\n\nAll procurement content comes from www.eprocure.gov.bd and is shown unchanged. Sign in only on the official portal pages; this app never stores your e-GP password.
Sign in with your Google account to start your free 7-day trial. Your trial and any purchase stay with your account, even on a new phone.
Use every feature free for 7 days. No payment details needed.
Unlock e-GP Browser for life with a one-time payment of ৳250. No subscription, no renewals. The e-GP portal itself stays free in any other browser.

resources.string: Clearing cookies or site storage ends your e-GP session on this device. Any unsaved work in open forms will be lost.
